deliverables: A self-contained enumeration of subsets of {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8} whose elements sum to 9.
A concise exhaustiveness argument that partitions all possible qualifying subsets into complete cases.
subquestions: Which distinct-element partitions of 9 use only elements from {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8}?
How can those partitions be put in one-to-one correspondence with the requested subsets?
Which case split establishes that no other subset can have sum 9?
